I have implemented the type-safe SQL window function helpers, frame builders, and named window support across all supported dialects on branch `feat/window-functions`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Functions & Frame Builders** ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), re-exported via [functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts) and the top-level package):
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L283-L286), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L291-L294), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L299-L302), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L308-L315), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L320-L323), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L328-L331)
   - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L338-L370), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L372-L404), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L409-L418), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L423-L432), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L438-L450) (nullable return type by default; `lag` and `lead` strip `null` when `defaultValue` is provided)
   - **Window aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L455-L458), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L463-L466), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L471-L480), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L485-L494), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L499-L505) (`count(*)` when called with no argument)
   - **Frame utilities & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L120-L123), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L128-L131), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L42-L45), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L50-L53), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L58-L61), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L76-L79), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L85-L88)
   - **Validation & raw numeric literals**: Numeric positional arguments are emitted via `sql.raw` so they never become bound parameters (including `0`), and `ntile`, `nthValue`, `preceding`, `following`, `rows`, `range`, and `.window()` enforce all input constraints.

2. **Named `.window(name, spec)` Select Builder Support Across Dialects**:
   - PostgreSQL: [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts)
   - MySQL: [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts)
   - SQLite: [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts)
   - SingleStore: [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts)
   - Gel: [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts)

3. **Tests**:
   - Added unit, type-inference, and SQLite runtime tests in [window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mxq8bjcu/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts).
